diagrams.name: composer_install_command_flow
diagrams.title: Composer Install Command Flow
diagrams.description: User runs `composer install`: CLI entry → BaseCommand bootstraps Composer instance → Installer.run() orchestrates the full install pipeline
diagrams.scope: CLI command bootstrap and install orchestration

diagrams.name: dependency_resolution_flow
diagrams.title: Dependency Resolution Flow
diagrams.description: Installer builds the repository set, creates a solver request, runs the SAT solver, and produces a lock transaction with resolved packages

diagrams.name: package_download_and_install_flow
diagrams.title: Package Download and Install Flow
diagrams.description: InstallationManager batches operations, invokes FileDownloader to download archives, then installs/updates packages on disk

diagrams.name: vcs_downloader_flow
diagrams.title: VCS Downloader Flow
diagrams.description: VcsDownloader clones or updates a VCS-tracked package: doDownload for fresh installs, doUpdate for upgrades, cleanup on failure

diagrams.name: vcs_repository_loading_flow
diagrams.title: VCS Repository Loading Flow
diagrams.description: VcsRepository initialises a VcsDriver (GitHub/GitLab), fetches composer.json per ref, validates branches, and builds the package list from cache or live API
diagrams.scope: VCS repository discovery and package enumeration

diagrams.name: composer_repository_package_loading_flow
diagrams.title: Composer Repository Package Loading Flow
diagrams.description: ComposerRepository fetches the packages.json index, verifies checksums, filters by stability, and asynchronously loads matching package metadata
diagrams.scope: Packagist-style repository index fetch and filtering

diagrams.name: plugin_lifecycle_flow
diagrams.title: Plugin Lifecycle Flow
diagrams.description: PluginManager checks plugin allowlist, activates plugins from global and local repos, loads plugin repositories, and deactivates them on cleanup
diagrams.scope: Plugin allow-check, activation, and repository loading

diagrams.name: show_command_flow
diagrams.title: Show Command Flow
diagrams.description: User runs `composer show`: ShowCommand queries installed and remote repositories, resolves version constraints, and renders package tree to ConsoleIO
diagrams.scope: Package listing and dependency tree display

diagrams.name: package_alias_resolution_flow
diagrams.title: Package Alias Resolution Flow
diagrams.description: Installer creates AliasPackage wrappers for branch aliases, replaces self-version references, and merges aliases into the repository set before resolution
diagrams.scope: Branch alias wrapping and self-version substitution

diagrams.name: perforce_vcs_driver_flow
diagrams.title: Perforce VCS Driver Flow
diagrams.description: Perforce utility checks server availability, generates p4 commands, fetches commit logs, and surfaces package metadata to VcsRepository
diagrams.scope: Perforce depot checkout and version discovery
